summary: Configured a persistent CORP.EXAMPLE Samba AD environment on the 10.83.0.0/24 identity network.
actions_performed: Provisioned replicated DCs on node1 (10.83.0.10) and node2 (10.83.0.11).
Created engineering and infrasetuser, with correct group membership.
Joined node3 as a file server and published the engineering share with ACLs and welcome.txt.
Joined node4 as a domain client and created /root/corp-user.env.
Configured dual-controller DNS/Kerberos failover and automatic Kerberos ticket refresh.
Verified replication, trust, DNS, Kerberos authentication, SMB write/modify/read access, and boot-persistent service configuration.
